items.stem: Assertion : When the length of a wire is doubled, then its resistance also gets doubled. Reason : The resistance of a wire is directly proportional to its length.

items.answer: (a) Both assertion (A) and reason (R) are true and reason (R) is the correct explanation of assertion (A). The resistance of a wire is R = ρl/A, so R ∝ l. Since the resistance of a wire is directly proportional to its length, when the length of a wire is doubled/halved its resistance also gets doubled/halved.

items.answer: (a) Both assertion (A) and reason (R) are true and reason (R) is the correct explanation of assertion (A). Heater wire must have high resistance and a high melting point, because in series the current remains the same, therefore according to Joule's law H = I²Rt the heat produced is high if R is high; the melting point must be high so that the wire may not melt with the increase in temperature.
items.assertion: Heater wire must have high resistance and high melting point.
items.reason: If resistance is high, the electric conductivity will be less.

items.stem: Assertion : If ρ₁ and ρ₂ be the resistivity of the materials of two resistors of resistances R₁ and R₂ respectively and R₁ > R₂. Reason : The resistance R = ρl/A ⇒ ρ₁ > ρ₂ if R₁ > R₂.
